     7→def cmake_layout(conanfile, generator=None, src_folder=".", build_folder="build"):
     8→    """
     9→    :param conanfile: The current recipe object. Always use ``self``.
    10→    :param generator: Allow defining the CMake generator. In most cases it doesn't need to be passed, as it will get the value from the configuration              ``tools.cmake.cmaketoolchain:generator``, or it will automatically deduce the generator from the ``settings``
    11→    :param src_folder: Value for ``conanfile.folders.source``, change it if your source code
    12→                       (and CMakeLists.txt) is in a subfolder.
    13→    :param build_folder: Specify the name of the "base" build folder. The default is "build", but
    14→                        if that folder name is used by the project, a different one can be defined
    15→    """
    16→    gen = conanfile.conf.get("tools.cmake.cmaketoolchain:generator", default=generator)
    17→    if gen:
    18→        multi = "Visual" in gen or "Xcode" in gen or "Multi-Config" in gen
    19→    else:
    20→        compiler = conanfile.settings.get_safe("compiler")
    21→        if compiler == "msvc":
    22→            multi = True
    23→        else:
    24→            multi = False
    25→
    26→    subproject = conanfile.folders.subproject
    27→    conanfile.folders.source = src_folder if not subproject else os.path.join(subproject, src_folder)
    28→    try:
    29→        build_type = str(conanfile.settings.build_type)
    30→    except ConanException:
    31→        raise ConanException("'build_type' setting not defined, it is necessary for cmake_layout()")
    32→
    33→    build_folder = build_folder if not subproject else os.path.join(subproject, build_folder)
    34→    config_build_folder, user_defined_build = get_build_folder_custom_vars(conanfile)
    35→    if config_build_folder:
    36→        build_folder = os.path.join(build_folder, config_build_folder)
    37→    if not multi and not user_defined_build:
    38→        build_folder = os.path.join(build_folder, build_type)
    39→    conanfile.folders.build = build_folder
    40→
    41→    conanfile.folders.generators = os.path.join(conanfile.folders.build, "generators")
    42→
    43→    conanfile.cpp.source.includedirs = ["include"]
    44→
    45→    if multi:
    46→        conanfile.cpp.build.libdirs = ["{}".format(build_type)]
    47→        conanfile.cpp.build.bindirs = ["{}".format(build_type)]
    48→    else:
    49→        conanfile.cpp.build.libdirs = ["."]
    50→        conanfile.cpp.build.bindirs = ["."]

    53→def get_build_folder_custom_vars(conanfile):
    54→    conanfile_vars = conanfile.folders.build_folder_vars
    55→    build_vars = conanfile.conf.get("tools.cmake.cmake_layout:build_folder_vars", check_type=list)
    56→    if conanfile.tested_reference_str:
    57→        build_vars = build_vars or conanfile_vars or \
    58→                     ["settings.compiler", "settings.compiler.version", "settings.arch",
    59→                      "settings.compiler.cppstd", "settings.build_type", "options.shared"]
    60→    else:
    61→        try:
    62→            is_consumer = conanfile._conan_node.recipe in (RECIPE_CONSUMER, RECIPE_EDITABLE)
    63→        except AttributeError:
    64→            is_consumer = False
    65→        if is_consumer:
    66→            build_vars = build_vars or conanfile_vars or []
    67→        else:
    68→            build_vars = conanfile_vars or []
    69→
    70→    ret = []
    71→    for s in build_vars:
    72→        group, var = s.split(".", 1)
    73→        tmp = None
    74→        if group == "settings":
    75→            tmp = conanfile.settings.get_safe(var)
    76→        elif group == "options":
    77→            value = conanfile.options.get_safe(var)
    78→            if value is not None:
    79→                if var == "shared":
    80→                    tmp = "shared" if value else "static"
    81→                else:
    82→                    tmp = "{}_{}".format(var, value)
    83→        else:
    84→            raise ConanException("Invalid 'tools.cmake.cmake_layout:build_folder_vars' value, it has"
    85→                                 " to start with 'settings.' or 'options.': {}".format(s))
    86→        if tmp:
    87→            ret.append(tmp.lower())
    88→
    89→    user_defined_build = "settings.build_type" in build_vars
    90→    return "-".join(ret), user_defined_build

   239→            return str(build_type).lower()

   242→class _IncludingPresets:
   243→    """
   244→    CMakeUserPresets or ConanPresets.json that include the main generated CMakePresets
   245→    """
   246→
   247→    @staticmethod
   248→    def generate(conanfile, preset_path, user_presets_path, preset_prefix, preset_data):
   249→        if not user_presets_path:
   250→            return
   251→
   252→        # If generators folder is the same as source folder, do not create the user presets
   253→        # we already have the CMakePresets.json right there
   254→        if not (conanfile.source_folder and conanfile.source_folder != conanfile.generators_folder):
   255→            return
   256→
   257→        user_presets_path = os.path.join(conanfile.source_folder, user_presets_path)
   258→        if os.path.isdir(user_presets_path):  # Allows user to specify only the folder
   259→            output_dir = user_presets_path
   260→            user_presets_path = os.path.join(user_presets_path, "CMakeUserPresets.json")
   261→        else:
   262→            output_dir = os.path.dirname(user_presets_path)
   263→
   264→        if not os.path.exists(os.path.join(output_dir, "CMakeLists.txt")):
   265→            return
   266→
   267→        # It uses schema version 4 unless it is forced to 2
   268→        inherited_user = {}
   269→        if os.path.basename(user_presets_path) != "CMakeUserPresets.json":
   270→            inherited_user = _IncludingPresets._collect_user_inherits(output_dir, preset_prefix)
   271→
   272→        if not os.path.exists(user_presets_path):
   273→            data = {"version": 4,
   274→                    "vendor": {"conan": dict()}}
   275→            for preset, inherits in inherited_user.items():
   276→                for i in inherits:
   277→                    data.setdefault(preset, []).append({"name": i})
   278→        else:
   279→            data = json.loads(load(user_presets_path))
   280→            if "conan" not in data.get("vendor", {}):
   281→                # The file is not ours, we cannot overwrite it
   282→                return
   283→
   284→        if inherited_user:
   285→            _IncludingPresets._clean_user_inherits(data, preset_data)
   286→        data = _IncludingPresets._append_user_preset_path(data, preset_path)
   287→
   288→        data = json.dumps(data, indent=4)
   289→        try:
   290→            presets_path = os.path.relpath(user_presets_path, conanfile.generators_folder)
   291→        except ValueError:  # in Windows this fails if in another drive
   292→            presets_path = user_presets_path
   293→        ConanOutput(str(conanfile)).info(f"CMakeToolchain generated: {presets_path}")
   294→        save(user_presets_path, data)
   295→
   296→    @staticmethod
   297→    def _collect_user_inherits(output_dir, preset_prefix):
   298→        # Collect all the existing targets in the user files, to create empty conan- presets
   299→        # so things doesn't break for multi-platform, when inherits don't exist
   300→        collected_targets = {}
   301→        types = "configurePresets", "buildPresets", "testPresets"
   302→        for file in ("CMakePresets.json", "CMakeUserPresets.json"):
   303→            user_file = os.path.join(output_dir, file)
   304→            if os.path.exists(user_file):
   305→                user_json = json.loads(load(user_file))
   306→                for preset_type in types:
   307→                    for preset in user_json.get(preset_type, []):
   308→                        inherits = preset.get("inherits", [])
   309→                        if isinstance(inherits, str):
   310→                            inherits = [inherits]
   311→                        inherits = [i for i in inherits if i.startswith(preset_prefix)]
   312→                        if inherits:
   313→                            existing = collected_targets.setdefault(preset_type, [])
   314→                            for i in inherits:
   315→                                if i not in existing:
   316→                                    existing.append(i)
   317→
   318→        return collected_targets
   319→
   320→    @staticmethod
   321→    def _clean_user_inherits(data, preset_data):
   322→        for preset_type in "configurePresets", "buildPresets", "testPresets":
   323→            presets = preset_data.get(preset_type, [])
   324→            presets_names = [p["name"] for p in presets]
   325→            other = data.get(preset_type, [])
   326→            other[:] = [p for p in other if p["name"] not in presets_names]
   327→
   328→    @staticmethod
   329→    def _append_user_preset_path(data, preset_path):
   330→        """ - Appends a 'include' to preset_path if the schema supports it.
   331→            - Otherwise it merges to "data" all the configurePresets, buildPresets etc from the
   332→              read preset_path.
   333→        """
   334→        if "include" not in data:
   335→            data["include"] = []
   336→        # Clear the folders that have been deleted
   337→        data["include"] = [i for i in data.get("include", []) if os.path.exists(i)]
   338→        if preset_path not in data["include"]:
   339→            data["include"].append(preset_path)
   340→        return data

   343→def load_cmake_presets(folder):
   344→    try:
   345→        tmp = load(os.path.join(folder, "CMakePresets.json"))
   346→    except FileNotFoundError:
   347→        # Issue: https://github.com/conan-io/conan/issues/12896
   348→        raise ConanException(f"CMakePresets.json was not found in {folder} folder. Check that you "
   349→                             f"are using CMakeToolchain as generator to ensure its correct "
   350→                             f"initialization.")
   351→    return json.loads(tmp)

   141→class _ConfValue(object):
   142→
   143→    def __init__(self, name, value, path=False, update=None):
   144→        if name != name.lower():
   145→            raise ConanException("Conf '{}' must be lowercase".format(name))
   146→        self._name = name
   147→        self._value = value
   148→        self._value_type = type(value)
   149→        self._path = path
   150→        self._update = update
   151→
   152→    def __repr__(self):
   153→        return repr(self._value)
   154→
   155→    @property
   156→    def value(self):
   157→        if self._value_type is list and _ConfVarPlaceHolder in self._value:
   158→            v = self._value[:]
   159→            v.remove(_ConfVarPlaceHolder)
   160→            return v
   161→        return self._value
   162→
   163→    def copy(self):
   164→        # Using copy for when self._value is a mutable list
   165→        return _ConfValue(self._name, copy.copy(self._value), self._path, self._update)
   166→
   167→    def dumps(self):
   168→        if self._value is None:
   169→            return "{}=!".format(self._name)  # unset
   170→        elif self._value_type is list and _ConfVarPlaceHolder in self._value:
   171→            v = self._value[:]
   172→            v.remove(_ConfVarPlaceHolder)
   173→            return "{}={}".format(self._name, v)
   174→        else:
   175→            return "{}={}".format(self._name, self._value)
   176→
   177→    def serialize(self):
   178→        if self._value is None:
   179→            _value = "!"  # unset
   180→        elif self._value_type is list and _ConfVarPlaceHolder in self._value:
   181→            v = self._value[:]
   182→            v.remove(_ConfVarPlaceHolder)
   183→            _value = v
   184→        else:
   185→            _value = self._value
   186→        return {self._name: _value}
   187→
   188→    def update(self, value):
   189→        assert self._value_type is dict, "Only dicts can be updated"
   190→        assert isinstance(value, dict), "Only dicts can update"
   191→        self._value.update(value)
   192→
   193→    def remove(self, value):
   194→        if self._value_type is list:
   195→            self._value.remove(value)
   196→        elif self._value_type is dict:
   197→            self._value.pop(value, None)
   198→
   199→    def append(self, value):
   200→        if self._value_type is not list:
   201→            raise ConanException("Only list-like values can append other values.")
   202→
   203→        if isinstance(value, list):
   204→            self._value.extend(value)
   205→        else:
   206→            self._value.append(value)
   207→
   208→    def prepend(self, value):
   209→        if self._value_type is not list:
   210→            raise ConanException("Only list-like values can prepend other values.")
   211→
   212→        if isinstance(value, list):
   213→            self._value = value + self._value
   214→        else:
   215→            self._value.insert(0, value)
   216→
   217→    def compose_conf_value(self, other):
   218→        """
   219→        self has precedence, the "other" will add/append if possible and not conflicting, but
   220→        self mandates what to do. If self has define(), without placeholder, that will remain.
   221→        :type other: _ConfValue
   222→        """
   223→        v_type = self._value_type
   224→        o_type = other._value_type
   225→        if v_type is list and o_type is list:
   226→            try:
   227→                index = self._value.index(_ConfVarPlaceHolder)
   228→            except ValueError:  # It doesn't have placeholder
   229→                pass
   230→            else:
   231→                new_value = self._value[:]  # do a copy
   232→                new_value[index:index + 1] = other._value  # replace the placeholder
   233→                self._value = new_value
   234→        elif v_type is dict and o_type is dict:
   235→            if self._update:
   236→                # only if the current one is marked as "*=" update, otherwise it remains
   237→                # as this is a "compose" operation, self has priority, it is the one updating
   238→                new_value = other._value.copy()
   239→                new_value.update(self._value)
   240→                self._value = new_value
   241→        elif self._value is None or other._value is None:
   242→            # It means any of those values were an "unset" so doing nothing because we don't
   243→            # really know the original value type
   244→            pass
   245→        elif o_type != v_type:
   246→            raise ConanException("It's not possible to compose {} values "
   247→                                 "and {} ones.".format(v_type.__name__, o_type.__name__))
   248→        # TODO: In case of any other object types?
   249→
   250→    def set_relative_base_folder(self, folder):
   251→        if not self._path:
   252→            return
   253→        if isinstance(self._value, list):
   254→            self._value = [os.path.join(folder, v) if v != _ConfVarPlaceHolder else v
   255→                           for v in self._value]
   256→        if isinstance(self._value, dict):
   257→            self._value = {k: os.path.join(folder, v) for k, v in self._value.items()}
   258→        elif isinstance(self._value, str):
   259→            self._value = os.path.join(folder, self._value)

   509→class ConfDefinition:
   510→    # Order is important, "define" must be latest
   511→    actions = (("+=", "append"), ("=+", "prepend"),
   512→               ("=!", "unset"), ("*=", "update"), ("=", "define"))
   513→
   514→    def __init__(self):
   515→        self._pattern_confs = OrderedDict()
   516→
   517→    def __repr__(self):
   518→        return "ConfDefinition: " + repr(self._pattern_confs)
   519→
   520→    def __bool__(self):
   521→        return bool(self._pattern_confs)

   523→    def get(self, conf_name, default=None, check_type=None, choices=None):
   524→        """
   525→        Get the value of the conf name requested and convert it to the [type]-like passed.
   526→        """
   527→        pattern, name = self._split_pattern_name(conf_name)
   528→        return self._pattern_confs.get(pattern, Conf()).get(name, default=default,
   529→                                                            check_type=check_type, choices=choices)

   531→    def show(self, fnpattern):
   532→        """
   533→        Get the value of the confs that match the requested pattern
   534→        """
   535→        result = {}
   536→
   537→        for patter_key, patter_conf in self._pattern_confs.items():
   538→            if patter_key is None:
   539→                patter_key = ""
   540→            else:
   541→                patter_key += ":"
   542→
   543→            pattern_values = patter_conf.show(fnpattern, patter_key)
   544→            result.update({patter_key + pattern_subkey: pattern_subvalue
   545→                           for pattern_subkey, pattern_subvalue in pattern_values.items()})
   546→
   547→        return result
   548→
   549→    def pop(self, conf_name, default=None):
   550→        """
   551→        Remove the conf name passed.
   552→        """
   553→        pattern, name = self._split_pattern_name(conf_name)
   554→        return self._pattern_confs.get(pattern, Conf()).pop(name, default=default)

   556→    @staticmethod
   557→    def _split_pattern_name(pattern_name):
   558→        if pattern_name.count(":") >= 2:
   559→            pattern, name = pattern_name.split(":", 1)
   560→        else:
   561→            pattern, name = None, pattern_name
   562→        return pattern, name

   564→    def get_conanfile_conf(self, ref, is_consumer=False):
   565→        """ computes package-specific Conf
   566→        it is only called when conanfile.buildenv is called
   567→        the last one found in the profile file has top priority
   568→        """
   569→        result = Conf()
   570→        for pattern, conf in self._pattern_confs.items():
   571→            if pattern is None or ref_matches(ref, pattern, is_consumer):
   572→                # Latest declared has priority, copy() necessary to not destroy data
   573→                result = conf.copy().compose_conf(result)

   576→    def update_conf_definition(self, other):
   577→        """
   578→        :type other: ConfDefinition

   580→        """

   585→        existing = self._pattern_confs.get(pattern)

   591→    def rebase_conf_definition(self, other):
   592→        """
   593→        for taking the new global.conf and composing with the profile [conf]

   596→        for pattern, conf in other._pattern_confs.items():
   597→            new_conf = conf.filter_user_modules()  # Creates a copy, filtered
   598→            existing = self._pattern_confs.get(pattern)

   604→    def update(self, key, value, profile=False, method="define"):
   605→        """
   606→        Define/append/prepend/unset any Conf line
   607→        >> update("tools.build:verbosity", "verbose")
   608→        """
   609→        pattern, name = self._split_pattern_name(key)
   610→
   611→        if not _is_profile_module(name):
   612→            if profile:
   613→                raise ConanException("[conf] '{}' not allowed in profiles".format(key))
   614→            if pattern is not None:
   615→                raise ConanException("Conf '{}' cannot have a package pattern".format(key))

   617→        # strip whitespaces before/after =

   619→        name = name.strip()

   621→        # When loading from profile file, latest line has priority
   622→        conf = Conf()
   623→        if method == "unset":
   624→            conf.unset(name)
   625→        else:
   626→            getattr(conf, method)(name, value)
   627→        # Update
   628→        self._update_conf_definition(pattern, conf)

   630→    def dumps(self):
   631→        result = []
   632→        for pattern, conf in self._pattern_confs.items():
   633→            if pattern is None:
   634→                result.append(conf.dumps())
   635→            else:
   636→                result.append("\n".join("{}:{}".format(pattern, line) if line else ""
   637→                                        for line in conf.dumps().splitlines()))
   638→        if result:
   639→            result.append("")
   640→        return "\n".join(result)

   642→    def serialize(self):
   643→        result = {}
   644→        for pattern, conf in self._pattern_confs.items():
   645→            if pattern is None:
   646→                result.update(conf.serialize())
   647→            else:

   649→                    result[f"{pattern}:{k}"] = v

   652→    @staticmethod
   653→    def _get_evaluated_value(__v):
   654→        """
   655→        Function to avoid eval() catching local variables
   656→        """
   657→        try:
   658→            # Isolated eval
   659→            parsed_value = eval(__v)  # This destroys Windows path strings with backslash
   660→            if isinstance(parsed_value, str):  # xxx:xxx = "my string"
   661→                # If it is quoted string we respect it as-is
   662→                parsed_value = __v.strip()
   663→        except:
   664→            # It means eval() failed because of a string without quotes
   665→            parsed_value = __v.strip()
   666→        return parsed_value

   668→    def loads(self, text, profile=False):
   669→        self._pattern_confs = {}
   670→
   671→        for line in text.splitlines():
   672→            line = line.strip()
   673→            if not line or line.startswith("#"):
   674→                continue
   675→            for op, method in ConfDefinition.actions:
   676→                tokens = line.split(op, 1)
   677→                if len(tokens) != 2:
   678→                    continue
   679→                pattern_name, value = tokens
   680→                parsed_value = ConfDefinition._get_evaluated_value(value)
   681→                self.update(pattern_name, parsed_value, profile=profile, method=method)
   682→                break
   683→            else:
   684→                raise ConanException("Bad conf definition: {}".format(line))

  1140→def test_cmake_toolchain_vars_when_option_declared():
  1141→    t = TestClient()
  1142→
  1143→    cmakelists = textwrap.dedent("""
  1144→    cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 2.8) # <---- set this to an old version for old policies
  1145→    cmake_policy(SET CMP0091 NEW) # <-- Needed on Windows
  1146→    project(mylib CXX)
  1147→
  1148→    message("CMake version: ${CMAKE_VERSION}")
  1149→
  1150→    # Set the options AFTER the call to project, that is, after toolchain is loaded
  1151→    option(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS "" ON)
  1152→    option(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE "" OFF)
  1153→
  1154→    add_library(mylib src/mylib.cpp)
  1155→    target_include_directories(mylib PUBLIC include)
  1156→
  1157→    get_target_property(MYLIB_TARGET_TYPE mylib TYPE)
  1158→    get_target_property(MYLIB_PIC mylib POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE)
  1159→    message("mylib target type: ${MYLIB_TARGET_TYPE}")
  1160→    message("MYLIB_PIC value: ${MYLIB_PIC}")
  1161→    if(MYLIB_PIC)
  1162→        #Note: the value is "True"/"False" if set by cmake,
  1163→        #       and "ON"/"OFF" if set by Conan
  1164→        message("mylib position independent code: ON")
  1165→    else()
  1166→        message("mylib position independent code: OFF")
  1167→    endif()
  1168→
  1169→    set_target_properties(mylib PROPERTIES PUBLIC_HEADER "include/mylib.h")
  1170→    install(TARGETS mylib)
  1171→    """)
  1172→
  1173→    t.run("new cmake_lib -d name=mylib -d version=1.0")
  1174→    t.save({"CMakeLists.txt": cmakelists})
  1175→
  1176→    # The generated toolchain should set `BUILD_SHARED_LIBS` to `OFF`,
  1177→    # and `CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE` to `ON` and the calls to
  1178→    # `option()` in the CMakeLists.txt should respect the existing values.
  1179→    # Note: on *WINDOWS* `fPIC` is not an option for this recipe, so it's invalid
  1180→    #       to pass it to Conan, in which case the value in CMakeLists.txt
  1181→    #       takes precedence.
  1182→    fpic_option = "-o mylib/*:fPIC=True" if platform.system() != "Windows" else ""
  1183→    fpic_cmake_value = "ON" if platform.system() != "Windows" else "OFF"
  1184→    t.run(f"create . -o mylib/*:shared=False {fpic_option} --test-folder=")
  1185→    assert "mylib target type: STATIC_LIBRARY" in t.out
  1186→    assert f"mylib position independent code: {fpic_cmake_value}" in t.out
  1187→
  1188→    # When building manually, ensure the value passed by the toolchain overrides the ones in
  1189→    # the CMakeLists
  1190→    fpic_option = "-o mylib/*:fPIC=False" if platform.system() != "Windows" else ""
  1191→    t.run(f"install . -o mylib/*:shared=False {fpic_option}")
  1192→    folder = "build/generators" if platform.system() == "Windows" else "build/Release/generators"
  1193→    t.run_command(f"cmake -S . -B build/ -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE={folder}/conan_toolchain.cmake")
  1194→    assert "mylib target type: STATIC_LIBRARY" in t.out
  1195→    assert f"mylib position independent code: OFF" in t.out
  1196→
  1197→    # Note: from this point forward, the CMakeCache is already initialised.
  1198→    # When explicitly overriding `CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE` via command line, ensure
  1199→    # this takes precedence to the value defined by the toolchain
  1200→    t.run_command("cmake -S . -B build/ -DCMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE=ON")
  1201→    assert "mylib target type: STATIC_LIBRARY" in t.out
  1202→    assert "mylib position independent code: ON" in t.out
  1203→
  1204→    t.run_command("cmake -S . -B build/ -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON")
  1205→    assert "mylib target type: SHARED_LIBRARY" in t.out
  1206→    assert "mylib position independent code: ON" in t.out

import json
import os
import platform
import textwrap

import pytest

from conans.test.utils.tools import TestClient
from conans.util.files import load


def _generators_folder_with_name(client, name_token):
    """Return path to generators folder depending on platform and name token used in build folder."""
    if platform.system() == "Windows":
        return os.path.join(client.current_folder, "build", name_token, "generators")
    else:
        return os.path.join(client.current_folder, "build", name_token, "Release", "generators")


def _read_presets(presets_path):
    assert os.path.exists(presets_path)
    return json.loads(load(presets_path))


def _save_recipe(client, name=None):
    conanfile = textwrap.dedent(
        f"""
        from conan import ConanFile
        from conan.tools.cmake import CMakeToolchain, cmake_layout

        class Pkg(ConanFile):
            {('name = "%s"' % name) if name else ''}
            version = "1.0"
            settings = "os", "compiler", "build_type", "arch"
            generators = "CMakeToolchain"
            exports_sources = "CMakeLists.txt"
            def layout(self):
                cmake_layout(self)
        """
    )
    cmakelists = textwrap.dedent(
        """
        cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)
        project(dummy)
        add_library(dummy STATIC dummy.cpp)
        """
    )
    client.save({"conanfile.py": conanfile, "CMakeLists.txt": cmakelists, "dummy.cpp": "void f(){}"},
                clean_first=True)


def test_cmake_presets_self_name_single_config():
    client = TestClient(path_with_spaces=False)
    _save_recipe(client, name="sub1")
    # Use only self.name so build folder should be build/sub1[/Release]/generators
    conf = '-c tools.cmake.cmake_layout:build_folder_vars=\'["self.name"]\''
    client.run(f"install . {conf} -s build_type=Release")

    gen_folder = _generators_folder_with_name(client, "sub1")
    presets_path = os.path.join(gen_folder, "CMakePresets.json")
    presets = _read_presets(presets_path)

    if platform.system() == "Windows":
        # Multi-config: configure preset has no build_type suffix
        assert presets["configurePresets"][0]["name"] == "conan-sub1"
        # Build preset includes selected configuration
        assert presets["buildPresets"][0]["name"] == "conan-sub1-release"
        assert presets["buildPresets"][0]["configurePreset"] == "conan-sub1"
    else:
        # Single-config: both include build_type suffix
        assert presets["configurePresets"][0]["name"] == "conan-sub1-release"
        assert presets["buildPresets"][0]["name"] == "conan-sub1-release"
        assert presets["buildPresets"][0]["configurePreset"] == "conan-sub1-release"


@pytest.mark.skipif(platform.system() != "Windows", reason="Requires multi-config default generator")
def test_cmake_presets_self_name_multi_config():
    client = TestClient(path_with_spaces=False)
    _save_recipe(client, name="sub1")
    conf = '-c tools.cmake.cmake_layout:build_folder_vars=\'["self.name"]\''
    client.run(f"install . {conf} -s build_type=Release")
    client.run(f"install . {conf} -s build_type=Debug")

    gen_folder = _generators_folder_with_name(client, "sub1")
    presets_path = os.path.join(gen_folder, "CMakePresets.json")
    presets = _read_presets(presets_path)

    # Configure preset includes only the custom token
    assert presets["configurePresets"][0]["name"] == "conan-sub1"
    # Build presets include different configurations and keep naming with self.name
    names = [p["name"] for p in presets["buildPresets"]]
    assert "conan-sub1-release" in names
    assert "conan-sub1-debug" in names
    for p in presets["buildPresets"]:
        assert p["configurePreset"] == "conan-sub1"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("compiler,expected_compiler_token",
                         [("gcc", "gcc"), ("apple-clang", "apple-clang"), ("msvc", "msvc")])
def test_cmake_presets_self_name_combined_order(compiler, expected_compiler_token):
    client = TestClient(path_with_spaces=False)
    _save_recipe(client, name="pkgname")
    # Combine self.name with another var and build_type, preserving order and lowercase
    conf = '-c tools.cmake.cmake_layout:build_folder_vars=\'["self.name", "settings.compiler", "settings.build_type"]\''
    settings = f'-s compiler={compiler} -s build_type=Release'
    client.run(f"install . {settings} {conf}")

    # Name token includes all in order: self.name, compiler, build_type
    token = f"pkgname-{expected_compiler_token}-release"
    gen_folder = _generators_folder_with_name(client, token)
    presets_path = os.path.join(gen_folder, "CMakePresets.json")
    presets = _read_presets(presets_path)

    expected_name = f"conan-{token}"
    assert presets["configurePresets"][0]["name"] == expected_name
    # Build preset naming should also include the same token
    assert presets["buildPresets"][0]["name"] == expected_name if platform.system() == "Windows" else expected_name


def test_cmake_presets_self_name_missing():
    client = TestClient(path_with_spaces=False)
    # Consumer recipe without name
    _save_recipe(client, name=None)
    conf = '-c tools.cmake.cmake_layout:build_folder_vars=\'["self.name", "settings.build_type"]\''
    client.run(f"install . {conf} -s build_type=Release")

    # Since name is missing, only build_type should be used
    token = "release"
    gen_folder = _generators_folder_with_name(client, token)
    presets_path = os.path.join(gen_folder, "CMakePresets.json")
    presets = _read_presets(presets_path)

    expected_name = f"conan-{token}"
    assert expected_name == presets["configurePresets"][0]["name"]
    # Ensure 'None' is not injected anywhere
    content = json.dumps(presets)
    assert "None" not in content and "none" not in content


def test_cmake_layout_build_folder_vars_invalid_token_message():
    client = TestClient(path_with_spaces=False)
    _save_recipe(client, name="pkg")
    # Passing an invalid token should raise with message mentioning allowed tokens
    bad_conf = '-c tools.cmake.cmake_layout:build_folder_vars=\'["foo.bar"]\''
    client.run(f"install . {bad_conf}", assert_error=True)
    assert "Invalid 'tools.cmake.cmake_layout:build_folder_vars' value" in client.out
    assert "settings." in client.out and "options." in client.out and "self.name" in client.out
